task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the yellow and black code scanner, grab the leaf-patterned green tea storage, and scan it with the yellow and black code scanner
